name: From Mudblood to Atlantis' Owner
overview:
In Atlantis, only godblood mermaids are allowed to live. Mudbloods are crushed at birth.

I, Princess Rosalie, am a mudblood.

My mother used dark magic to hide it. But on the day I gave birth, my husband Xavier discovered the truth, and I died by his hand.

Now I'm reborn. I reject Xavier and choose to marry a mute slave instead.

They all laugh. They say I've lost my mind.

But they don't know the truth. He's not just a slave. He's Pure Godblood. The rarest, most powerful bloodline in Atlantis.
